invariants.contract: PATCH tracks with a new order stores the audio files in that order with index 1..n, manuallyVerified true and exclude false, answers the old-format item and emits item_updated. Excluding a file stores exclude true with index -1 and sorts it first, renumbers the others from 1, and the item's tracks no longer include it. Sending the original order restores indexes 1..3 with exclude false; the identical request again answers 200 with the same stored order.
